script: Hi, this is Marcus Oyelaran calling about my beagle, Biscuit. About twenty minutes ago he got into a whole bag of dark chocolate chips off the counter, and he's already drooling and shaking a bit. I don't know what to do. Please call me back as soon as you hear this, my number is five five five, oh one four two.

Hello, Dana Whitcombe here. My cat Pepper has been limping on her back left leg since last night. She's still eating and purring, she just won't put weight on it. I'd like to get her seen today if there's any room. You can reach me at five five five, oh one seven seven.

Good morning, it's Tomas Brandt. I need a refill on Juniper's thyroid tablets, I've got about a week left. No rush, any time this week is fine. My number is five five five, oh one nine nine. Thanks very much.

Hi there, Priya Natarajan. This is probably nothing, but my rabbit Clover hasn't eaten anything or made any droppings since yesterday morning, and her belly feels kind of hard. Sorry to bother you. Whenever someone gets a chance, I'm at five five five, oh one one three.

Hi, Gwen Albright. I'd like to book Milo, he's a four month old kitten, for his next round of vaccines, and maybe talk about getting him neutered. Mornings are best for me. You can call five five five, oh one six eight.
